newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday on short covering, traders said.

They said a deal was done in the afternoon at 43.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan for September shipment and at 43.75 for October shipment. Buyers bought rubber at 43.00 fob Palembang for August shipment and at 43.25 for September shipment.
Another deal was done at 43.00 fob Padang for September shipment.
"In general, traders are quite happy with this trend. But we are also aware this may reverse anytime because the rises have been triggered by shortcovering," said one trader in Padang, West Sumatra.

"We do not see this trend as an indication to future direction because the market sentiment is still bearish. Traders in general have taken a take-it-easy approach because the rise is not that sharp," said another trader, adding that SIR20 was mostly bought by Singapore dealers.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 43.00 fob Surabaya for August shipment and at 43.50 for October shipment. Levels were quoted 43.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
